brief:
Tents in Gaza have ceased to serve as mere emergency shelter, according to Shehab Wire, but now stand as material witness to one of the harshest episodes of mass displacement in contemporary Palestinian history. What began as a temporary response to forced migration has become a permanent symbol of systematic population uprooting.

The encampments represent far more than basic housing solutions for the displaced. They embody the scale and severity of an ongoing displacement process that has fundamentally altered the landscape of Palestinian society.

title: Israel transforms Gaza displacement camps into humanitarian catastrophe
